use default
use Raster.Anchor
use Raster.IMAGE

use Stroke = (x0: double, y0: double, x1: double, y1: double)

let glyphs: Stroke[][] = [
    [],
    [(0.0D, 3.0D, 1.0D, 3.0D)],
    [(0.0D, 2.0D, 1.0D, 2.0D)],
    [(0.0D, 3.0D, 1.0D, 2.0D)],
    [(0.0D, 2.0D, 1.0D, 3.0D)],
    [(0.0D, 3.0D, 1.0D, 3.0D), (0.0D, 2.0D, 1.0D, 3.0D)],
    [(1.0D, 2.0D, 1.0D, 3.0D)],
    [(0.0D, 3.0D, 1.0D, 3.0D), (1.0D, 2.0D, 1.0D, 3.0D)],
    [(0.0D, 2.0D, 1.0D, 2.0D), (1.0D, 2.0D, 1.0D, 3.0D)],
    [
        (0.0D, 3.0D, 1.0D, 3.0D), (0.0D, 2.0D, 1.0D, 2.0D),
        (1.0D, 2.0D, 1.0D, 3.0D)
    ]
]

let numbers = [0, 1, 20, 300, 4000, 5555, 6789, 1978]

let cell = 90.0D
let unit = 22.0D

draw(image: IMAGE, number: int, left: double) is
    let centre = left + cell / 2.0D
    let base = 40.0D

    image.stroke(3.0D)
    image.line(centre, base, centre, base + 3.0D * unit)

    let place mut = number

    for quadrant in 0..4 do
        let flip_x = if quadrant % 2 == 1 then -1.0D else 1.0D fi
        let flip_y = quadrant >= 2

        for s in glyphs[place % 10] do
            let y0 = if flip_y then 3.0D - s.y0 else s.y0 fi
            let y1 = if flip_y then 3.0D - s.y1 else s.y1 fi

            image.line(
                centre + flip_x * s.x0 * unit, base + y0 * unit,
                centre + flip_x * s.x1 * unit, base + y1 * unit)
        od

        place = place / 10
    od

    image.text(centre, 12.0D, 12.0D, "{number}", Anchor.CENTRE)
si

let width = cast int(cell) * numbers.count
let image = IMAGE(width, 130)

image.view(0.0D, 0.0D, cast double(width), 130.0D)
image.clear(250ub, 247ub, 238ub)
image.colour(60ub, 40ub, 30ub)

for (i, number) in numbers |> index() do
